metadata.name: roulette
metadata.description: Roulette3 table: player safes, sessions, sealed-envelope rounds, investor bank pool

accounts.name: buyback_token
docs: The public buyback wallet's account for this currency — never one the table itself holds.

accounts.name: new_buyback_token
docs: Of the table's currency, and never an account the table itself holds (the vault): money sent there would be
stuck and still reported as sent.

instructions.name: version
docs: The program's version (a harmless call used to check the build end to end).

errors.name: NoThrows
errors.msg: Throw count must be at least 1

errors.name: StakeInRound
errors.msg: A stake is still in an unsettled round

errors.name: WrongRoundStatus
errors.msg: Round is not in the right state

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Bets must be whole dollars, at least 1

errors.name: RandomnessArrived
errors.msg: The randomness has arrived: the round can only be revealed

errors.name: TooSoon
errors.msg: The next round opens a few seconds after the last one

errors.name: NotAllSettled
errors.msg: Not all bets of this round are settled

errors.name: WrongSeed
errors.msg: The seed does not match the round's sealed envelope

errors.name: EntropyNotReady
errors.msg: The entropy slot does not exist yet

errors.name: EntropyGone
errors.msg: The entropy slot has left Solana's history: the round can only be forfeited

errors.name: TooEarlyToForfeit
errors.msg: The dealer still has time to reveal

errors.name: BondLimit
errors.msg: The owner's guarantee cannot cover more bets this round

errors.name: InsufficientBond
errors.msg: Not that much in the owner's guarantee

errors.name: TooEarlyToChange
errors.msg: The change is not due yet: 7 days' notice

types.name: Bet
docs: One bet as recorded on-chain: a spot (index into spots::SPOTS) and whole dollars.

fields.name: shares
docs: All shares, including those waiting to be withdrawn (they keep sharing wins and losses until paid).

fields.name: invested
docs: Plain counters for the Bank page (money is never computed from them): all put in, all taken out, first joined.

fields.name: liabilities
docs: What the pool pays (stakes back + winnings) if number n wins.

fields.name: commitment
docs: The sealed envelope: sha256 of the dealer's secret seed, published when the round opened.

fields.name: seed
docs: Revealed: the seed, and the slot and hash it was mixed with.

fields.name: best_total
docs: Sum of every player's best case (what a forfeit pays them).

fields.name: forfeited
docs: The dealer did not reveal in time: each player got their best case and the pool its best case, paid by the
owner's guarantee; no fee; number is NO_NUMBER.

fields.name: owed
docs: Still to be credited to winners' safes.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the account's rent (gets it back when the round is closed).

fields.name: best
docs: The most these bets can pay (what a forfeit pays).

fields.name: done
docs: Settled or refunded.

fields.name: pending_round
docs: Round whose bets are not settled or refunded yet (0: none).

fields.name: key
docs: The browser's key that may place bets for `wallet` (and do nothing else).

fields.name: unit
docs: Base units per dollar (10^decimals).

fields.name: round_id
docs: Id of the latest round (0: none yet) and its status.

fields.name: pool
docs: Ledger inside the vault: vault balance = safes_total + pool + escrow_total + owed_total + bond + buyback_owed.

fields.name: bond
docs: The owner's guarantee: pays for a forfeited round (every player and the pool at their best case). Every bet set
must fit what it can cover; it leaves the vault only between rounds.

fields.name: round_closed_at
docs: When the latest round was revealed or voided (the next may open ROUND_GAP_SECS later).

fields.name: buyback_token
docs: The public buyback wallet's token account. Half of every fee is set aside for it (rules::split_fee, a constant)
and anyone may send what is set aside (pay_buyback). No round depends on this account.

fields.name: buyback_owed
docs: Set aside in the vault for the buyback account, not sent yet.

fields.name: buyback_paid
docs: Sent to the buyback account so far.

fields.name: pending_buyback_token
docs: A new buyback account the owner proposed (Pubkey::default(): none), and from when anyone may apply it.
